name: Digital Product Passport (UNTP)
description: UN Transparency Protocol 0.7.0 Digital Product Passport: a product or batch, its identifiers, category, origin and performance claims, published by its producer.
summary: Credential type template for the UNTP 0.7.0 DigitalProductPassport, a W3C VCDM 2.0 credential (jwt_vc_vcdm) with the UNTP context and schema. It is issued with no holder and published as a "dpp" link in the issuer's did:web DID document (untpLinkType), as in workflows/dpp-workflow.md. The form covers the Product (identifiers, identifier scheme, category, facility and country of production) and its performance claims, each with one criterion, one measured value, one conformity topic and one evidence link to the DCC behind it; tw-web-app adds the UNTP types and wraps those into the arrays the schema expects. Issued by the noop/dpp_supplier and noop/dpp_manufacturer wallet templates.
